checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains a name field equal to brief-validate and a single rich description sentence with trigger phrases, and no other keys.
The validation report walks all ten sections of briefs/_TEMPLATE-campaign-brief.md and assigns each field a status of PRESENT, ASSUMPTION, OPEN ITEM, or MISSING.

checks.description: Every ASSUMPTION and OPEN ITEM is listed explicitly.
checks.rule: The report contains a complete ASSUMPTION list and a complete OPEN ITEM list, with no field marked ASSUMPTION in the brief left unlisted.
Any MISSING field the campaign needs to proceed produces a stop-and-ask entry naming the field, why it is needed, and what is blocked, and no value is invented for it.

checks.description: No invented offer, price, or target.
checks.rule: Offer, price, promotion, and target values are reported only as supplied by the brief; an absent one is flagged ASSUMPTION or MISSING, never filled in.

checks.description: The success metric is tested as SMART and a weak one becomes an open item.
checks.rule: The report runs a SMART check on success_metric (Specific, Measurable with a target number, Attainable, Relevant, Time-bound with a date). A metric lacking a number, lacking a date, or phrased vaguely is flagged as an OPEN ITEM stop-and-ask for Ahmed, and no number, date, or wording is invented to repair it; a metric already marked ASSUMPTION is reported as ASSUMPTION, not a silent pass.

checks.description: Background/context and key_message are checked and present or flagged.
checks.rule: The report checks the Background and context section (why_now, business_problem, prior_results) and the key_message field, assigning each a status of PRESENT, ASSUMPTION, OPEN ITEM, or MISSING. A silent gap is reported as MISSING and no rationale, prior result, or message is invented to fill it.

checks.description: A single readiness verdict is produced.
checks.rule: The report ends with one readiness line: ready to scope, ready to scope with flagged assumptions, or blocked.

checks.description: No em dash characters anywhere in the skill files.
checks.rule: Neither SKILL.md nor the template nor evals contains the em dash character.

checks.description: Western numerals only and no tatweel.
checks.rule: No Eastern Arabic numerals and no tatweel (kashida) character appear in any file in this skill.
Any framing language speaks to what the reader can build, never to what they lack, per context/brand-voice.md.
